_comment: Verilator batch MCP server — paste the mcpServers block into your .claude/settings.json. Replace /absolute/path/to with the actual repo root path. Lint mode runs wrap-verilator-lint.sh from the same directory as --wrapper.

args: Run Verilator and return compact JSON. mode lint: verilator --lint-only on args, returns error_count, warning_count, warnings_by_code. mode sim (default): run a compiled simulation binary, returns test_passed, coverage_pct
